name: obsidian
description: Obsidian session tracking: /compress saves the current session as a structured log, /resume loads project context.

vault_name.title: Vault name
vault_name.description: Name of your Obsidian vault (the vault folder name as shown in Obsidian). The plugin resolves its full path automatically from Obsidian's vault registry.

vault_path.title: Vault path (optional override)
vault_path.description: Absolute path to the vault folder. Leave empty to auto-resolve by vault name from Obsidian's registry. Set it to work without Obsidian installed (e.g. headless machines) or to disambiguate same-named vaults; when set, it takes precedence over the registry lookup.
